decisions.reason: As a core everyday rye bread, it suits the bakery’s traditional assortment well and is less exposed now that one overlapping rye variant was already removed.
The premium raisin Christmas stollen remains a flagship seasonal item whose gold medal distinction supports both prestige and holiday sales.
This dark barley malt rye bread still fits the artisanal bread profile, but its more niche taste and overlap with other dark breads keep withdrawal risk relatively higher.
Marzipan Christmas stollen is a fitting seasonal confectionery variant for gifting and holiday trade, though it is somewhat more expendable than the award-backed flagship stollen.
The ancient grain bread aligns strongly with the firm’s handcrafted, traditional and natural positioning and therefore is likely to stay in the assortment.
